# AROPL FARSI — دین صلح و نور احمدی

> Persian-language site of the Ahmadi Religion of Peace and Light (AROPL),
> presenting the teachings of Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq, the Qa'im of the
> family of Muhammad. Books, videos and study resources in Persian (and some
> English), for seekers of truth.

## Pages

- [Home — دین صلح و نور احمدی](https://aroplfarsi.pages.dev/): Books, videos and selected resources.
- [Religion overview — معرفی دین صلح و نور](https://aroplfarsi.pages.dev/religion-of-peace-and-light/): What the Ahmadi Religion of Peace and Light is, who Abdullah Hashem Aba Al-Sadiq is, the holy will, and the black banner.
- [The Goal of the Wise — دانلود کتاب هدف حکیم](https://aroplfarsi.pages.dev/books/the-goal-of-the-wise/): The book "The Goal of the Wise" (December 2022, 42 chapters). Persian PDF download, audio reading, official download. Winner — Italy International Book Award 2025.
- [The Mahdi's Manifesto — دانلود مانیفست مهدی](https://aroplfarsi.pages.dev/books/the-mahdis-manifesto/): The 31-page booklet "The Mahdi's Manifesto" (2024). Persian PDF download, audio reading, official download.
- [Study — مطالعه](https://aroplfarsi.pages.dev/study): Study texts and resources in Persian and English.
